preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some NOMOS tokens to initiate transfer
Contract must have accumulated ETH balance from previous token swaps (swapAndLiquify must have been triggered)

exploit_hint: The contract has a reentrancy vulnerability in the swapAndLiquify function due to unsafe external calls. Create a malicious contract that implements a fallback/receive function. Trigger swapAndLiquify by selling tokens to the pair when contract balance exceeds minimumTokensBeforeSwap. During the addLiquidity call, the receive() function will be called with ETH. Re-enter the contract by calling withdraw() or another function that transfers ETH before state updates are complete. This allows draining the contract's ETH balance.
